title: MemoryRecordsDeleteRequest
description: Delete a record: content is removed, the tombstone is retained, and the record leaves recall and default export (MEM-R014, MEM-R022). Receipts are unaffected because they are content-free. Grant: records_write covering the placement. Mutating op: requires idempotency_key (§7.0.5) and returns a MemoryReceipt whose result is a content-free summary (§7.0.2).

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason recorded on the tombstone.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen, 1–128 characters (§6.1); unique within the dedup namespace (space_id, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key) (§7.0.5).
